in_sanskrit.name: निमा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who provides rest, relaxation, peace, and tranquility. In Hinduism, Nima is a name of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity, who is believed to bestow peace, happiness, and wealth upon her devotees.

in_hindi.name: निमा
in_hindi.meaning: निमें (nimēṃ) - to rest, to remain, to stay, to be
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who remains, stays, is present, and provides rest. In Hindi, Nima can be used as a name for a girl, meaning 'the one who remains' or 'the peaceful one'.

in_tamil.name: நிமா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who provides rest, peace, and tranquility. In Tamil, Nima can be used as a name for a girl, meaning 'the peaceful one'.

in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who provides rest, peace, and tranquility. In Telugu, Nima can be used as a name for a girl, meaning 'the peaceful one'.

in_marathi.name: Nima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nima is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'nima' which means 'night'. In Hindu mythology, there are several goddesses with this name, such as Nima Naka, a goddess of the underworld, The name Nima is also believed to signify the power and strength of the night, and the goddesses who protect and nurture during the dark hours.
